steps.label: Fixed supply
steps.sub: hard cap at genesis, never mints more

steps.label: Capped supply
steps.sub: ceiling exists, minted gradually toward it

steps.label: Deflationary
steps.sub: circulating supply actively shrinks via burns

eyebrow: Circulating vs. total vs. max supply
code:
Max supply      = the hard ceiling (or "none" if uncapped)
Total supply    = everything minted so far
Circulating     = total supply minus locked/vesting/treasury

Example:
  Max supply:               1,000,000,000
  Total supply:                600,000,000
  Locked/vesting/treasury:     250,000,000
  Circulating supply:          350,000,000
caption: Market cap built on total supply overstates how much is actually liquid right now.

code:
net_supply_change = emissions_minted - tokens_burned

One year:
  Staking emissions minted:      20,000,000
  Transaction-fee burns:         25,000,000

net_supply_change = 20,000,000 - 25,000,000 = -5,000,000
caption: Net-deflationary even while the protocol is still actively minting staking rewards.
